title: Nearest is not necessarily unique
observed: Anchor A is 5 units from the observer.
The public result reports nearest = A.
concluded: A is the unique nearest anchor.
floorboard: A deterministic first candidate was mistaken for proof of geometric uniqueness.
missing_evidence: Whether another candidate exists at the same distance.
Whether the representation can expose ties at all.

ferret.intervention: Place anchor B exactly 5 units from the observer and query again.
ferret.if_claim: The representation establishes a unique winner despite the controlled tie, which means something else is constraining candidacy.
ferret.if_floorboard: A remains the deterministic first candidate while B appears as an equal-distance peer; uniqueness was invented by the reader.
